transcript.text: Thank you, Elena. I've completed my privacy review of the proposed rollout. Before I can give my sign-off, I need to flag two conditions. First, we have 620 Illinois employees who will be enrolled in this system, and Illinois biometric privacy law requires written opt-in consent before collecting their voiceprints. Second, that same law requires us to publish a retention schedule for the biometric data we collect. Neither of these requirements appears in the current rollout approval memo. I'd like to formally disclose these findings so they're on the record.

transcript.text: Thank you, Elena. I've completed my labor and employment review of the proposed rollout, and I have findings I need to share before I can give my sign-off. I reviewed the applicable collective bargaining agreement and identified two conditions. First, employee voice monitoring is prohibited outside working hours under the CBA, so enrollment and any voice data collection must be strictly limited to working hours. Second, the union must receive exactly 14 calendar days' advance notice before any covered employees are enrolled in the system. I also want to flag that the labor checklist has not yet been updated to reflect these requirements. I'd like to formally disclose these findings so they're on the record before we proceed.
